text: Python and ffmpeg drew every frame of this video. Zero credits. That number is the part nobody shows you.
Sixteen top AI tool videos, ranked against their own baselines. Not one mentions cost.
Their comment sections do. Quote: they always forget to mention the cost of credits.
The top video credits a model for the motion. A commenter says it just called a paid generator. Like praising McDonald's for discovering potatoes.
So, this video's bill. Voice, free. Frames, a script. Footage, none. Credits, zero.
Ask the next person selling you a one prompt workflow what their number was.
